next.reason: 1985: "The INVALID KEY phrase must be specified if no applicable USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure is specified for file-name-1."; 2023: "GR-9.1.14-3: or there are no applicable exception processing statements, control is transferred to the end of the input-output statement.". 2023 calls INVALID KEY optional (GR-14.9.41.4-6) and defines the result when neither it nor a USE procedure exists, so the 1985 requirement is dropped.
